title: PS1 save-format catalogue
scope: Original PlayStation memory-card saves only; 26 research entries, 24 with public implementation references and two historical editor leads.
evidenceBoundary: Original survey preserved. The twelve-game proposal is now implemented as narrow read-only summaries for the exact real-save-tested product codes documented in docs/save-details.md. User PAL FFVII and public completion/endgame saves were used; upstream region claims do not imply support. Selected uploader values and checksums were checked without console or emulator playback.
proposalNote: Implemented as a first useful field set at the user request; full editor field coverage and unvalidated regions remain research work.
validationChecklist: Confirm the exact product code, region and revision before decoding.
Check layout and checksums; keep unknown or malformed revisions explicit.
Compare selected fields with known in-game values and retain regression fixtures.
Preserve multiple in-game profiles and linked blocks when decoding card saves and MCS snapshots.
Verify source and asset licenses before adapting code or mappings.
Keep capture timestamps distinct from original save dates.
architectureDirection: Use a shared read-only decoder interface with explicit per-game/revision detection. Normalize card containers and reconstruct linked save payloads before decoding. Start with a small useful field set and compare it across snapshots.
excluded: Generic memory-card managers, savestate-only tools, ROM editors, remaster-only editors. This shortlist is not an exhaustive census.
